acceptanceCriteria: When a customer purchases a return trip ticket with a promo code applied, the Mozio email confirmation displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound trip and the return trip.

When the Mozio email confirmation is generated for an order containing multiple line items representing a round trip (outbound and return), the promo code discount amount appears in the return trip section of the email, matching the format and value shown for the outbound trip.

When a customer purchases a one-way trip ticket with a promo code applied, the Mozio email confirmation displays the promo code discount amount for that single trip, and no return trip discount line is rendered.

When a return trip order has a promo code with a discount amount of zero or the promo code is invalid, the Mozio email confirmation does not display a promo code discount line for either the outbound or return trip.

When the order payload contains line items where the return trip has reversed fromStation and toStation codes relative to the outbound trip, the system correctly identifies the return trip and renders the promo code discount amount in the corresponding section of the Mozio email confirmation.
before.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation
before.title: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation

acceptanceCriteria: When a return trip ticket with a promo code is submitted to Mozio, the dispatch payload for the return trip includes the discount amount in report.price.discount, matching the value and format of the outbound trip dispatch.
When a one-way trip ticket with a promo code is submitted to Mozio, the dispatch payload includes the discount amount in report.price.discount, and no return trip dispatch is created.

When a return trip order has a promo code with a discount amount of zero or the promo code is invalid, the dispatch payload for both outbound and return trips omits the discount field (no discount line rendered in the email).

When the return trip dispatch has reversed fromStation/toStation relative to the outbound trip, the discount amount is still correctly included in the return trip dispatch payload after the station swap is applied.
The mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch function correctly maps the discount field for both outbound and return trip dispatches without masking or dropping the discount amount value.

Unit tests assert that (a) applyReportDiscountsService propagates the discount to the return trip dispatch so that report.price.discount.amount.value equals the applied discount amount and report.price.discount.amount.currency matches the outbound dispatch currency, and (b) mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch preserves discount.amount.value and discount.amount.currency unchanged from the input dispatch while masking only discount.name.
after.description: When a customer purchases a return trip ticket with a promo code, the Mozio email confirmation does not display the promo code discount amount for the return trip. The discount data is not being correctly propagated into the Mozio dispatch payload for return trip tickets, likely in the reservation creation mapper where from/to stations are swapped for return trips.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code discount amount not displayed for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

When a one-way trip ticket with a promo code is submitted to Mozio, the dispatch payload includes the discount amount in report.price.discount, and no return trip dispatch is created.

When a return trip order has a promo code whose evaluated discount amount is zero, the dispatch payload for both outbound and return trips omits the discount field entirely (no discount line rendered in the email).

When a return trip order has a promo code that is invalid (expired, not found, or rejected by the discount service), the dispatch payload for both outbound and return trips omits the discount field entirely.

When the return trip dispatch has reversed fromStation/toStation relative to the outbound trip, the discount amount is still correctly included in the return trip dispatch payload after the station swap is applied.

When the sanitized Mozio dispatch is produced for either outbound or return trip, discount.amount.value and discount.amount.currency are preserved unchanged from the input dispatch, while discount.name is masked.

When the outbound trip dispatch has no discount field (e.g., promo code evaluation returned null or undefined), the return trip dispatch also has no discount field, and dispatch generation completes without error.

notes: AC3 was split into two separate criteria (new AC3 for zero discount, new AC4 for invalid promo code) because they are distinct conditions that may have different code paths and need independent testability. AC5 was merged with AC6(b) since they overlapped — AC5 was vague ('correctly maps without masking or dropping') and AC6(b) made it specific (preserve value/currency, mask name); the merged AC6 replaces both. AC6(a) was absorbed into original AC1 which already covers 'matching the value and format of the outbound trip dispatch'. AC7 added as an edge case for when the outbound discount field is absent, ensuring the return trip gracefully handles missing discount data without crashing. Flagged the term 'invalid promo code' for human clarification on what invalidity conditions exist in the discount service.
